geometry.description: Mathematical geometry shapes using optimized Patches and PatchCollection.
geometry.example:
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots()

# Efficiently adding multiple shapes
circle = mpatches.Circle((0.5, 0.5), radius=0.2, color='blue', alpha=0.5)
rect = mpatches.Rectangle((0.1, 0.1), 0.3, 0.2, color='red', alpha=0.5)
poly = mpatches.RegularPolygon((0.8, 0.8), 5, radius=0.1, color='green')

ax.add_patch(circle)
ax.add_patch(rect)
ax.add_patch(poly)
ax.set_aspect('equal')

implicit_inequality.description: Plotting non-functional relations (circles, ellipses) and regional inequalities using SymPy.
implicit_inequality.example:
from sympy import symbols
from sympy.plotting import plot_implicit
x, y = symbols('x y')

# Implicit Circle and Region Inequality
p1 = plot_implicit(x**2 + y**2 - 25, (x, -7, 7), (y, -7, 7), show=False)
p2 = plot_implicit(y > x**2, (x, -5, 5), (y, -10, 25), show=False)
p1.extend(p2)
p1.show()
